formula_conventions.adjusted_ohlc: raw OHLC multiplied by the same-date frozen adj_factor convention
formula_conventions.execution: signal after t close; earliest entry t+1 eligible open
formula_conventions.market_r1: equal-weight mean r1 of the frozen same-date eligible universe
formula_conventions.rank_cs: same-date average-tie percentile rank on eligible non-missing observations
formula_conventions.rolling_windows: backward-looking, include t, and require the full declared window
formula_conventions.zero_denominator: observation is missing/denied unless the formula explicitly adds epsilon
